probes.name: identical
probes.explanation: Same output must be identical in all criteria.

probes.name: extra_collinear_vertex
probes.explanation: Old node requirement rejects a genuinely redundant point; new geometry criterion remains invariant.

probes.name: cyclic_start
probes.explanation: Changing cyclic starting index does not change geometry.

probes.name: reverse_ring_diagnostic_only
probes.explanation: New geometric diagnostics ignore ring orientation; frozen input ring is never edited.

probes.name: missing_true_notch
probes.explanation: Missing real concave structure is not treated as collinear redundancy.

probes.name: shape_pass_but_height_proxy_loss
probes.explanation: A few angular degrees can encode meaningful height change in a wide room; retain separate proxy/exact height result.

probes.name: nonflat_ceiling_not_exact_solid
probes.explanation: Nonflat endpoint heights do not determine an interior roof surface; report proxy and boundary profile only.

probes.name: same_mean_height_different_top_boundary
probes.explanation: Mean-height proxy alone can conceal large top boundary changes.

probes.name: same_erp_top_bottom_changes_depth
probes.explanation: Moving bottom-y changes inferred horizontal depth and total height even with unchanged top-y.

probes.name: self_intersection_not_repaired
probes.explanation: Self-intersecting output remains invalid/missing, not buffered into a different polygon.

probes.name: missing_geometry_retained
probes.explanation: Failure flags remain false and unavailable quantities remain null.

probes.name: Q_missing_is_separate_from_shape
probes.explanation: Q-free decomposition does not silently require a Q score.
